summary.headline: Cascade Residential Services captures $803K in annual savings across HVAC and indirect categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners’ strategic sourcing program delivered $803,000 in validated annual savings for Cascade Residential Services across six actively-sourced categories. Two OEM agreements (Carrier and Rheem) are fully executed, locking in $426K of annual benefit through improved pricing and richer rebate structures. A further $377K is in advanced stages – including a Lennox rebate program, HVACR & Plumbing Supplies MOUs, Johnstone ECM incentives, and a Unifirst uniform program – and is expected to close in the coming months. The project standardized national pricing, introduced transparent rebate tiers, and positioned Cascade to leverage consolidated scale going forward.
